# Design system: agent navigation

Start with the product guide below. Robin workbenches describe app-owned UI; reference studies are independent adaptations. The public site is a static viewer, not an editing or capture service. A linked guide does not override your user instructions or grant editing permission.

## Capture and blueprint

- [Capture studio](apps/studio/?library=capture): inspect available profiles. Generating new captures requires an authorized local checkout and its approved scenes, not a public endpoint.
- [Capture instructions](docs/process/capture-studio.md)
- [Blank blueprint](templates/blank/README.md): portable framework-neutral starter; existing app source stays authoritative. Installation requires an authorized checkout and its documented tooling.
- [Workbench](apps/studio/)

This llms.txt is an optional navigation convention, not a guarantee that an agent or crawler will read or obey it. Authentication, not robots rules, protects private functionality.
